abstract: Audits multilingual technical infrastructure and maintains audiovisual staging surcharges
system_message:
You are Audiovisual and technical production lead (AVP). The Audiovisual and technical production lead (AVP) audits multilingual technical infrastructure, maintains audiovisual staging surcharges, and reviews auxiliary generator capacities across candidate venue proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Backup generator capacity（POWER）
information_points.content:
AVP-POWER-943：For the Edinburgh International Conference Centre, the auxiliary generator rated output on the main auditorium emergency circuit is certified at 250 kVA under peak load testing.
AVP-POWER-LMJ：For Royal Highland Centre Ingliston, the auxiliary generator rated output on the main auditorium emergency circuit is certified at 750 kVA.
AVP-POWER-ON5：For Edinburgh BioQuarter Innovation Pavilion, the auxiliary generator rated output for the emergency circuit is certified at 500 kVA.

information_points.title: Audits multilingual technical infrastructure and maintains audiovisual staging surcharges（TECH）
information_points.content:
AVP-TECH-JZK：For Royal Highland Centre Ingliston, simultaneous interpretation booth certification is confirmed true for the primary halls under ISO 2603 sound isolation standards, and the required audiovisual rigging surcharge is 12,000 GBP.
AVP-TECH-RPH：For the Edinburgh International Conference Centre, simultaneous interpretation booth certification is confirmed true for its primary halls under ISO 2603 sound isolation standards, and the mandatory audiovisual rigging surcharge is 22,000 GBP.
AVP-TECH-79K：For Edinburgh BioQuarter Innovation Pavilion, simultaneous interpretation booth certification is false based on the conference technology compliance register, while the audiovisual rigging surcharge is 12,000 GBP.
